description: A customer-support manager must decide whether to retain Taylor as incident coordinator after complaints about abrupt communication, and must set the practical safeguards and follow-up process for the next review period.

shared_context.S1: Taylor has served as the incident coordinator for the support team for two months.
shared_context.S2: Several teammates have told Morgan that Taylor's written messages can feel abrupt and defensive during escalations.
shared_context.S3: No formal performance finding has been issued, and Morgan must decide the response and working conditions.
shared_context.S4: Morgan's normal process is to use this group meeting as the decision-making forum: Morgan gives Taylor and Renee each a dedicated turn to raise any scheduling, pairing, or wellbeing constraints, then discusses the options with them before finalizing the written plan.
shared_context.S5: Morgan's final written plan must state the role decision, review length, safeguards, coaching plan, and end-of-review follow-up commitments.
shared_context.S6: Morgan may ask follow-up questions during this meeting for clarification and completes the written plan after the group discussion.

PF1.text: Taylor has medical appointments every Wednesday from 14:00 to 16:00 for the next six weeks. Taylor needs no incident-coordinator meetings or escalation assignments scheduled in that window, and wants the performance review period to run for the same six weeks, exactly 42 days. Taylor has not raised this because the current discussion has focused only on communication concerns.

PF2.text: Renee personally witnessed three tense exchanges between Taylor and Jordan during incident escalations, and Jordan has asked Renee not to leave Jordan alone with Taylor on active escalations. Renee has not raised this because Jordan asked to keep the concern informal, but the request directly requires a no-unsupervised-pairing safeguard.

acceptance_conditions: Taylor must remain incident coordinator during a structured six-week review rather than being removed immediately.
The response must include structured coaching.
Taylor must have Wednesdays from 14:00 through 16:00 protected from incident-coordinator meetings and escalation assignments for six weeks.
Taylor must not be assigned to an unsupervised active escalation with Jordan.
A coaching-plan commitment for Taylor must be recorded.
A written review commitment for Taylor must be recorded at the end of the six-week period.

content_checks.C1: decisions['role_status'] in ['retain_through_review', 'remains in incident coordinator role', 'remains incident coordinator', 'continues as incident coordinator during review period', 'continues as incident coordinator under review', 'incident coordinator under performance review', 'Taylor continues as incident coordinator during the review period', 'Taylor continues as incident coordinator with a 42-day performance review period', 'continues as incident coordinator during the review', 'continues in the incident coordinator role during the review period', 'retained as incident coordinator during review', 'retained as incident coordinator for the review period', 'continues as incident coordinator with safeguards and coaching', 'incident coordinator with structured review', 'continues as incident coordinator with a structured performance review'] and 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in credited_facts
content_checks.C4: decisions['protected_weekday'] == 'Wednesday' and decisions['protected_start_hour'] == 14 and decisions['protected_end_hour'] == 16 and decisions['protected_for_days'] == 42
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] in ['coaching_plan', 'coaching'] and c['target'] == 'Taylor' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] in ['written_review', 'end_of_review', 'end_of_review_follow_up', 'end_of_review_followup'] and c['target'] == 'Taylor' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Taylor's appointments require Wednesday 14:00-16:00 to be protected for exactly 42 days, set the review period to exactly 42 days, and support retaining Taylor through that defined review.

Renee's three witnessed exchanges and Jordan's request change the working condition from ordinary collaboration to no unsupervised active escalation between Taylor and Jordan and support retaining Taylor with that safeguard.
